extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, grantee institutions, institutional administrators, and NIH staff responsible for application, award management, and compliance
extracted.subtask_description: Complying with NIH Grants Policy Statement requirements for applying for, receiving, managing, and closing out NIH grant awards, including eligibility, financial management, human subjects protections, reporting, and intellectual property rules. Covers both individual and institutional training awards, construction, SBIR/STTR, foreign awards, and special program-specific terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility requirements for applicants and grantees (general eligibility rules across mechanisms).

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and rules governing different application types (competing, non-competing, renewal, supplement, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about funding opportunity announcements and related requirements for applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements for submitting applications to the NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Forms / Required Forms for Competing Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Which forms are required for competing applications and how to complete them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Table 1: Required Forms for Competing Applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Receipt Points and Deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Receipt locations and cut-off dates for applications and related timing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal Implication of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal effects and responsibilities created by submission of an application to NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of Information (Proprietary Information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing protection of proprietary or confidential information submitted with applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Peer Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and procedures governing peer review of applications, including criteria and process steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures used during the initial scientific/technical review of applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Advisory Council or Board Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Role and procedures of advisory councils or boards in the second-level review of applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals of Initial Scientific Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Process and grounds for appealing the outcome of initial scientific review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disposition of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: How NIH disposes of applications (funding, deferral, withdrawal, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Completing the Preaward Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps and requirements to complete between award decision and issuance of the Notice of Grant Award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles guiding NIH funding decisions and allocation of funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Analysis and Assessment of Management Systems
rubrics_metrics.description: How NIH assesses applicant cost proposals and management systems for award administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Terms and Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of standard terms and conditions that apply to NIH grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Policy Requirements and Objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: List and description of public policy requirements that affect NIH awards (e.g., civil rights, environment, human subjects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Table 2: Public Policy Requirements and Objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical and Safe Conduct in Science and Organizational Operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectations for ethical behavior and safe operations in NIH-funded research and organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and disclosure requirements for financial and other conflicts of interest affecting NIH-supported research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debarment and Suspension
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements regarding recipients or individuals who are debarred or suspended from federal programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drug-Free Workplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies requiring grantees to maintain a drug-free workplace as a condition of award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health and Safety Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Health and safety requirements that institutions must follow when conducting NIH-funded activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation on Use of Funds for Promotion or Legalization of Controlled Substances
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions on use of grant funds for activities that promote or legalize controlled substances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lobbying
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions and disclosure requirements for lobbying activities funded or influenced by NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misconduct in Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and procedures governing allegations and findings of research misconduct in NIH-funded work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nondelinquency on Federal Debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that grantees not be delinquent on federal debt to remain eligible for NIH funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recombinant DNA and Institutional Biosafety Committees
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements relating to recombinant DNA research and institutional biosafety oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions on Distribution of Sterile Needles
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies limiting the use of funds for programs that distribute sterile needles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seat Belt Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement or encouragement regarding seat belt use for activities supported by NIH funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smoke-Free Workplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy promoting or requiring smoke-free workplaces where NIH funds are used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements Affecting Rights and Welfare of Research Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements that protect the rights and welfare of human subjects, patients, or recipients of services in NIH-funded research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ban on Human Embryo Research and Cloning
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies regarding funding restrictions for human embryo research and cloning activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of Patient Records
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules protecting patient record confidentiality in NIH-supported research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controlled Substances
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing research that involves controlled substances under NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Human subjects protections, including requirements for IRB review, informed consent, and related safeguards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigational New Drug (IND) Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements when NIH-funded research involves investigational new drugs and FDA IND submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro-Children Act of 1994
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance requirements under the Pro-Children Act for NIH-funded programs involving children.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Research Subjects' Identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards to protect the identity of participants in NIH-funded research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research on Transplantation of Fetal Tissue
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and restrictions relating to NIH support for research involving fetal tissue transplantation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal Welfare
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for humane care and use of animals in NIH-funded research, including institutional oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Inclusiveness in Research Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectations that research design include appropriate representation (e.g., sex/gender, racial/ethnic groups) as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities as Subjects in Clinical Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific NIH policy requiring consideration and inclusion of women and minorities in clinical research unless justified otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children as Subjects in Clinical Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy addressing when children must be included in clinical research and related protections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civil Rights and Non-Discrimination Statutes
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations under statutes such as the Age Discrimination Act (1975), Civil Rights Act (1964), Education Amendments (1972), and Rehabilitation Act (1973).

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental Impact and Construction-related Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental and other requirements related to acquisition, alteration, renovation, and construction of facilities using NIH funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of Information / Acknowledgment of Federal Funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for acknowledging NIH support and making information about funded work available to the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Freedom of Information Act (FOIA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicability of FOIA to NIH-funded records and procedures for information requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Privacy Act
rubrics_metrics.description: Privacy Act obligations and protections for personal data in NIH-funded projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Grant Award (NGA)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Notice of Grant Award as the official notification of funding along with its terms and conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding and Budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on funding amounts, budget preparation, allowable budget categories, and modifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment and Cash Management (SMARTLINK II/ACH, CASHLINE/ACH, Monthly Cash Request)
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods and procedures for obtaining cash payments, electronic funds transfer systems, and monthly cash requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interest Earned on Advances of Grant Funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for handling interest earned on NIH grant advances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Principles / The Cost Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles determining allowability, allocability, and reasonableness of costs charged to NIH grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct Costs and Facilities and Administrative (Indirect) Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and treatment of direct costs versus facilities and administrative (F&A) or indirect costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Transfers, Overruns, and Accelerated and Delayed Expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies regulating transfers between accounts, handling of cost overruns, and timing of expenditures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation of Costs and Closely Related Work
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on allocating costs when work is closely related across funding sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable Credits
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements to credit applicable funds or receipts against costs charged to NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Services Provided by Affiliated Organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment of services provided by affiliated organizations and their cost allowability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of Costs/Activities and Selected Items of Cost
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules about which costs/activities are allowable or unallowable and itemized cost treatments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative responsibilities of grantees, including compliance, reporting, and recordkeeping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Changes in Project and Budget / Prior Approval Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: When grantees must seek NIH prior approval for changes in project scope, budget, key personnel, or transfer of award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes guidance on expanded authorities and requests for approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expanded Authorities / Streamlined Noncompeting Award Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which NIH grants can be administered with expanded authorities and streamlined processes for continuations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Noncompeting Continuation Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing continuation awards including progress reporting and funding increment processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of Research Results: Publications and Intellectual Property Rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and rights regarding publication of results and intellectual property arising from NIH-funded research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights in Data (Publication and Copyrighting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on data rights, publication rights, and copyright issues for NIH-funded work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unique Research Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectations for sharing unique research resources and associated policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents / Invention Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for reporting inventions, patent rights, and related reporting to NIH and agency offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Final Invention Statement and Certification and reporting to the Office of Research Integrity where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Systems and Procedures / Financial Management System Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for financial management systems and institutional procedures to ensure proper stewardship of NIH funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income (Reporting and Treatment)
rubrics_metrics.description: How program income is defined, reported, and treated under NIH awards, including sale of real property and equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Property Management System Standards (Real Property, Equipment, Supplies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for managing real property, equipment, exempt and nonexempt property, and dispositions under NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement System Standards and Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing procurement, approval requirements, and contracting rules (including small/minority/women-owned business contracting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring and Reporting (Progress Reports, Financial Reports, Unobligated Balances)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for periodic monitoring and submission of progress and financial reports; treatment of unobligated balances and actual expenditures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report to the Office of Research Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and procedures for reporting misconduct or required notifications to the Office of Research Integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lobbying Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure requirements related to lobbying activities associated with NIH-funded projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record Retention and Access
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations to retain project records and provide access for review or audit purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for audits of grantee financial systems and procedures and corrective actions where necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforcement Actions (Suspension, Termination, Withholding of Support)
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH's enforcement remedies, including suspension, termination, withholding of support, and other enforcement actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recovery of Funds and Debt Collection
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for recovering funds and collecting debts owed to the federal government.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout (Final Reports, Final Financial Status Report, Final Progress Report)
rubrics_metrics.description: Closeout obligations for completed awards, including submission of final financial and progress reports and final invention statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Appeals Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures by which grantees can appeal administrative decisions or other adverse actions related to grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terms and Conditions for Specific Grant Types and Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Special terms and conditions that apply to particular grant mechanisms, grantee types, or activities (construction grants, NRSA, SBIR/STTR, foreign awards, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III for detailed, mechanism-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction Grants: Eligibility and Review/Approval
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific eligibility, review, approval, funding, and administrative requirements for NIH construction grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes public policy, NEPA, flood insurance, historic properties, and applicable building and safety standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction Grants: Allowability of Costs/Procurement Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Cost allowability and procurement rules specific to construction and alteration/renovation projects under NIH grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Research Service Awards (NRSA) – Individual Fellowships: Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility criteria for individual NRSA fellowships including research areas, training program fit, and degree requirements (predoctoral, postdoctoral, senior).

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Individual Fellowships: Citizenship and Sponsorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Citizenship requirements and rules on sponsorship (including foreign sponsorship) for NRSA fellows.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Individual Fellowships: Financial Provisions (Stipends, Allowances)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stipend levels, supplementation rules, compensation, institutional allowance, tuition and fees, travel, and taxability for NRSA recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Individual Fellowships: Reporting Procedures and Payback
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting obligations (activation, payback agreements, termination notice) and payback service or financial payback rules for NRSA recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Institutional Training Grants: Eligibility and Degree Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility and degree-level training requirements for institutional NRSA training grants (predoctoral, postdoctoral, short-term, prebaccalaureate).

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Institutional Grants: Minority Recruitment and Responsible Conduct of Research Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Review criteria and program expectations including minority recruitment plans and training in responsible conduct of research.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Institutional Grants: Financial Provisions and Rebudgeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional financial rules for stipends, trainee costs, tuition, rebudgeting of trainee-related expenses, and facilities & administrative costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Institutional Grants: Reporting (Statement of Appointment, Payback Agreement, Termination Notice)
rubrics_metrics.description: Required forms and procedures for appointing trainees, certifying payback status, and reporting terminations for institutional NRSA programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support of Scientific Meetings (Conference Grants): Applicability and Allowable Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, application, allowable costs, and administrative requirements for conference grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium Agreements: Administrative and Other Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for consortium agreements, including intellectual property, program income, audit, and written agreements between institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards to Foreign Institutions / Domestic Grants with Substantial Foreign Components
rubrics_metrics.description: Special eligibility, review, public policy, funding, allowability, and administrative rules for awards involving foreign institutions or substantial foreign components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to Federal Institutions and Payments to Federal Employees
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies for grants awarded to federal institutions and for payments to or on behalf of federal employees under grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to For-Profit Organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, allowability of costs, cost principles, profit/fee policies, IR&D costs, and F&A treatment for for-profit grantees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, public policy requirements, allowability of costs and fee/profit, F&A costs, and administrative requirements specific to SBIR/STTR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Patient Care Costs: Definitions and Allowability
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies defining research patient care costs, their allowability, computation, and special procedures for hospitals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grantees and Consortium Participants/Contractors: Financial Responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial responsibilities, program requirements, and oversight obligations for grantees, consortium participants, and contractors under grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Part IV: Points of Contact / Master List of Links
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact information and links for programmatic and administrative inquiries related to the NIH Grants Policy Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides central references and contact points for policy clarification.
